rule: Every mandatory journey must be PASS. NOT_RUN, FAILED or BLOCKED keeps release at NO-GO.

journeys.title: Cold start opens app successfully
steps: Launch Reise mit Worten from the device home screen.
Observe the first rendered app screen.
expected: App does not crash or close unexpectedly.
A valid RMW screen is visible.
No unrecoverable error screen is shown.

journeys.title: App can be backgrounded and resumed
steps: Send the app to the background.

journeys.title: App survives process restart
expected: No corrupt-state or migration failure is shown.

journeys.title: Home screen primary actions are reachable
steps: Tap each visible primary navigation action once and return where possible.
expected: No primary action causes a crash.

journeys.title: No-network cold start is recoverable
preconditions: Disable Wi-Fi and mobile data before launch
steps: Launch Reise mit Worten with the device offline.
expected: App does not crash while offline.
Offline or recoverable state is understandable.
App can continue or recover after network returns.
